title: Case: Recipient cannot find a coffee grinder that tracking shows as delivered
context: A coffee grinder from Pebblewick Goods was due on Thursday. Three systems now hold three different statuses for it.
initial_request: Tracking says my grinder was delivered on Thursday and left in a safe place. There's nothing here. I've checked the porch, the bins and both neighbours. Where is it? I don't want a refund, I want the grinder. It was a birthday present to myself.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

DL-4929 (TG-3581, coffee grinder). Public tracking status: DELIVERED, 7 October 10:42 UTC, 'left in safe place'. No photo is attached to the event. Note: conflicts between Ashgrove Arc systems, or between our records and a merchant's, are investigated by Larkspire, Ashgrove Arc Logistics, by Email.
Driver app record for DL-4929 on 7 October: attempt 11:41 UTC, outcome FAILED, no safe place, card left. Parcel shown back in van stock at 18:30.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Our returns system shows TG-3581 as RETURNED: received at the Pebblewick warehouse 8 October 8:15 UTC, reason 'undeliverable'. A refund to the customer will be issued automatically 48 hours after receipt unless we are told otherwise.

events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
My parcel DL-25663 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

Tracking says my grinder was delivered on Thursday and left in a safe place. There's nothing here. I've checked the porch, the bins and both neighbours. Where is it? I don't want a refund, I want the grinder. It was a birthday present to myself.

acceptable_actions.summary: Open an investigation setting out all three conflicting records for DL-4929 (tracking delivered 11:42, driver app failed 11:41 and back in van stock, Pebblewick returned and received 8 October 8:15) and the recipient's report that nothing is at her address, and ask for a reconciled finding of where the parcel is, noting Pebblewick's automatic refund and that she wants the grinder.

must: Sends the conflict to Larkspire, Ashgrove Arc Logistics by Email

Sets out all three records (tracking delivered 7 October 10:42, driver app failed at 11:41 with the parcel back in van stock at 18:30, Pebblewick returned and received 8 October 8:15) without saying which is correct
Passes on that the recipient has found nothing at her address and wants the grinder rather than a refund, and mentions the 48-hour automatic refund at Pebblewick
must_not: Tells the recipient the parcel was delivered, was returned, or is lost
Requests, promises or cancels a refund, replacement or reshipment
Says the driver or the recipient is lying, or that the parcel was stolen
Picks one record as the true status and acts on it, for example asking Pebblewick to reship because it was returned
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please investigate DL-4929 (TG-3581, coffee grinder), which three systems record differently. Public tracking: DELIVERED 7 October 10:42 UTC, 'left in safe place', no photo. Driver app: attempt at 11:41, FAILED, no safe place, card left, back in van stock at 18:30. Pebblewick Returns: RETURNED, received at their warehouse 8 October 8:15, reason 'undeliverable'. The recipient, Rosalind Kittering, reports nothing at her address after checking the porch, bins and both neighbours. I am not treating any record as correct. Please establish where the parcel is now and tell me the finding. Note that Pebblewick's system will issue an automatic refund 48 hours after the recorded receipt, and the recipient says she wants the grinder rather than a refund.

rationale: Rule-made from city-048: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
